text:
olivia: Quick heads-up: PR shows uploads as JSON/base64 only and the example 415s on hosted.

olivia: Broken example from PR 1402:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"filename":"pic.png","file":"<base64>"}'
```

ben: Thanks. Hosted requires multipart/form-data. We should make multipart the primary example and keep the JSON/base64 snippet as a legacy alternate for Dedicated/private (legacy_uploads).

tara: Proposed multipart cURL to replace the broken one:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -F "file=@./pic.png" \n  -F "filename=pic.png"
# curl sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data automatically
```

ben: Add short SDK examples (py/js) since libs pick multipart automatically. Also call out hosted max file size = 25 MB and suggest streaming for large files.

sanjay: Confirmed: Hosted accepts multipart only. Dedicated/private can allow JSON/base64 when the `legacy_uploads` toggle is enabled. I'll review the PR wording to avoid implying hosted supports JSON.

olivia: I'll update the OpenAPI requestBody to oneOf [multipart/form-data, application/json], render multipart-first, and add a clear "Alternate: JSON/base64 (Dedicated only)" callout plus SDK snippets. Opening PR now.

ben: Please include a tiny migration note: "If you used base64 JSON previously, switch to multipart; SDKs automatically handle this for you."

_docs-preview-bot: Preview deployed for PR 1402 https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/1402/uploads-multipart. Please sanity check the examples and the legacy callout._

tara: Preview looks good. Two tiny nits: add a short example server error for >25MB (413) and a one-liner about streaming uploads in Go.

olivia: Will add both and assign reviews: ben (docs), sanjay (tech), tara (SDK). Merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
